subject: VitalCare MAP: evaluation playbook and deployment-region decision
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@vitalcare.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: MAP & evaluation playbook for VitalCare (next steps + timelines)

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and an evaluation playbook that aligns the technical PoC, security checklist, and procurement milestones. Key asks from our side to lock the sprint:

- Confirm target region for the PoC (we assume US-East for latency and data residency)
- Agree on deployment modes to validate in PoC: Hosted (fastest), Dedicated (throughput predictability), Private (VPC / on-prem) — we recommend testing Hosted + Dedicated fallback during the 3-week PoC
- Provide a list of systems that will send inference traffic (approx QPS and peak concurrency)
- Procurement: point-of-contact for contract and acceptance criteria

Attached: MAP_VitalCare_v1.pdf (summary + milestone dates)

Proposed coarse timeline:
Week 0: Kickoff + infra scoping
Week 1: PoC config + initial perf runs (hosted)
Week 2: Load/latency validation (dedicated pool) + security review
Week 3: Acceptance, handoff to integrations + procurement sign-off

We can tighten any of the above depending on your team’s availability. If you’re comfortable with the approach I’ll loop in our solutions lead and legal liaisons.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference

Attachment: MAP_VitalCare_v1.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@vitalcare.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reed <tom.reed@vitalcare.com>, ops@vitalcare.com
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 08:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MAP & evaluation playbook for VitalCare (next steps + timelines)

Thanks Stephanie — appreciate the clear plan. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Region: US-East is preferred (primary). We may request EU region later for a subset of PHI workflows, but that would be phase 2.
- Deployment modes: for the PoC we want to exercise Hosted for speed and Dedicated to validate consistent latency under simulated peak loads. Private (VPC) is a must-have for production but not required to be completed during the initial PoC.
- Traffic profile: ops@vitalcare.com will send a stub of expected call rates and payload sizes by EOD tomorrow.
- Procurement contact: Tom Reed (cc’d) — he’ll drive T&Cs and acceptance criteria.

Let’s keep Week 2 focused on an SLA/latency target and security artifacts (SOC2, logging, audit capability).

Sarah Lin
CTO, VitalCare Health
sarah.lin@vitalcare.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MAP & evaluation playbook for VitalCare (next steps + timelines)

Forwarding notes for the PoC scoping I mapped out with infra: 

- Recommendation: Start Hosted + Dedicated baseline. Hosted lets us get telemetry and correctness checks quickly; Dedicated validates throughput and KV cache behavior under stable cores.
- Private/VPC: scope as a parallel track only if VitalCare requires network-isolated verification during PoC; otherwise aim for a short Private acceptance sprint post-PoC.
- Test matrix (what to run):
  * Correctness & prompt regressions (small sample prompts) — Hosted
  * 99th pct latency at 512 tokens, 75 concurrent users — Dedicated
  * KV cache cold/warm scenario to show cost delta at sustained queries — Dedicated
  * Security checklist: SOC2 report, encryption-at-rest confirmation, audit logs (we can provide per-request tracing) — coordinate with Security

Marissa — can you add the resource estimates for a 2-week Dedicated pool (gpus, expected cost) so we can include in the MAP numbers?

-Karthik
Director, Inference Runtime
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Reed <tom.reed@vitalcare.com>, Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@vitalcare.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Kickoff: MAP & evaluation playbook for VitalCare (next steps + timelines)

Tom — looping you in on the technical outline and recommended test matrix. Could you confirm procurement milestones below and whether VitalCare needs a formal SOW? Quick answers requested so we can circulate a tightened MAP: 

- Procurement milestones we usually track:
  1) PoC sign-off (technical acceptance)
  2) Term sheet & pricing confirmation
  3) Contract signature / PO issuance
  4) Production onboarding

- Acceptance criteria: 99th percentile latency target, no critical security findings, and signed performance acceptance sheet.

If you prefer, we can submit a short SOW (1–2 pages) that maps the PoC deliverables to your acceptance criteria — we can attach as PoC_Scope_VitalCare.docx.

Thanks,
Stephanie

From: Tom Reed <tom.reed@vitalcare.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@vitalcare.com>
Cc: ops@vitalcare.com
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 10:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MAP & evaluation playbook for VitalCare (next steps + timelines)

Appreciate the outline. A few procurement/security items we need before kickoff: 

- SOC 2 type II report (latest) and a summary of your data retention policy
- SLA targets (p99 latency objective per model size) and escalation path for incidents
- Sample contract language or an SOW we can attach to our PO
- Estimated cost for the 2-week Dedicated validation (ballpark is fine)

If those are in your hands we can accelerate sign-off. We aim to start the PoC week of Jun 22, with technical sign-off by Jul 10.

Tom Reed
Head of Procurement, VitalCare
tom.reed@vitalcare.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Reed <tom.reed@vitalcare.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MAP & evaluation playbook for VitalCare (next steps + timelines)

Tom / team — attaching the short PoC SOW and a high-level estimate for the Dedicated validation. Highlights below: 

- Documents attached: PoC_Scope_VitalCare.docx, Dedicated_Estimate_Q2.pdf (estimates)
- SOC2: We will share our latest SOC2 Type II summary and a link to the full report under an NDA by EOD tomorrow.
- SLA targets we propose for the PoC: p95 < 120ms, p99 < 320ms for the 512-token baseline on Dedicated; hosted numbers will be slightly higher during cold-cache windows.
- Proposed onramp: start Jun 22 (init infra + config), perf window Jun 29–Jul 2, sign-off Jul 9–10.

If this aligns we’ll push the MAP_v1 dates into a final MAP document and open a DocuSign envelope for the SOW.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachment: PoC_Scope_VitalCare.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)
